review_scope: Nine complete feature/details/results/selection/publication/process fragments read. Twenty assertions retain 1,000-result sample cap, ten-repository selection limits, all-repository alternative, expression revision retesting, entitlement/version prerequisites and explicit publication. Linked syntax and images remain separate; no full-artifact accounting or rights/native/adoption certification.

claims.statement: AI custom-pattern generation is declared for fpt/ghec, with no GHES range in this pinned feature.
Pinned comments label AI generation Limited Public Beta and reference Team availability; comments are not live product entitlement proof.
A new custom pattern requires at least a pattern name.
A new custom pattern requires a regular expression for the secret format.
Optional surrounding-content and additional-match requirements can further constrain the expression; syntax is specified in a separate linked reference.
The procedure requires a sample test string to check expected matching; one sample is not exhaustive positive/negative coverage or permission to use real secrets.
The form screenshot has separate fpt/ghec and GHES branches; alt text is not binary image inspection or actual UI state.
Publication is an explicit Publish pattern operation following satisfaction with the new pattern, not automatic dry-run completion or enforcement.
Completed dry runs display a sample capped at 1,000 results; this visible sample must not replace the full matches denominator.
Reviewers are directed to identify false positives in dry-run results; absence in a sample is not whole-corpus precision evidence.
Problems require editing the pattern and another Save and dry run; a prior run is not evidence for a changed expression.
The result screenshot is a linked descriptive asset, not a completed target dry-run receipt.
The enterprise dry-run selection is capped at ten repositories, not automatically the whole enterprise.
Enterprise selection is followed by an explicit Run action; selection alone is not completed testing.
Organization dry runs offer an all-repositories selection branch.
The selected-repositories organization branch is capped at ten repositories and must retain its chosen target set.
Organization selection is followed by an explicit Run action; no actual run or completion was observed.
Organization creation starts with New pattern under Custom patterns, distinct from editing or enabling an existing pattern.
The product fragment limits custom patterns to organization-owned Team or Enterprise repositories with Secret Protection enabled; personal repository parity is not asserted.
The generic process fragment describes scanning entire Git history on all branches present in the repository; it is not measured scan completion or proof for absent/deleted branches.
